title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Fe Downs on 1982-10-17

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a high‑energy 1982 Santa Fe show with smoking Throwing Stones, The Other One and Althea, captured in surprisingly clear sound despite minor glitches.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this Santa Fe Downs concert is one of the best shows of ’82, highlighting an epic first set and a monster second set packed with Throwing Stones, Good Lovin', Wharf Rat, The Other One, Althea and Let It Grow. The audience tape is praised for its surprisingly crisp mix and vivid stage ambience, though a few listeners note occasional tech glitches and a noticeable cut in Althea. Overall the performance radiates high energy and strong playing from Jerry, Phil, Brent and the rest of the band.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (average ~4.8 ★) emphasize superb musical performance and generally good audio quality; minor glitches are noted but do not detract from overall enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape praised for clear, well‑balanced sound and vivid ambience. Some reviewers mention a few tech glitches and a noticeable cut/gap in Althea around the 7‑minute mark.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Epic first set followed by an even stronger second set with a long after‑drums segment (six songs) that flows seamlessly and keeps the energy soaring.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Strong vocal performance, "Jerry magic" and great guitar tone noted throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass "roars" on The Other One, delivering powerful, driving low end.
band_member_comments.Bob: Slide note embellishments heard during Throwing Stones; solid rhythm work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent added a special Santa Fe verse to Never Trust a Woman and overall keyboards received praise for the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: After‑drums segment highlighted as a standout, with tight and energetic playing.
